hero.headline:
Ethical Sourcing,
Made Simple.
hero.description: We connect purpose-led brands with textile manufacturers in India who are already certified, audited, and doing the work — renewable energy, fair labor, low-waste production.

intro.imageAlt: A certification shield with a copyright mark in front of a globe, leaves and garment pattern sketches
intro.text: At 79° East, we’re building a new model for manufacturing—one where sustainability, innovation, and transparency aren't optional, but foundational. Here’s why working with us makes a difference.

values.heading:
How We Vet Our
Manufacturing Partners
values.intro: We Only Work With Manufacturers Who Match Our Commitment To Sustainability, Ethics, And Innovation. Here’s What We Look For—And Why It Matters To You:

items.title: Deep Commitment To Sustainable Practices
items.body: Sustainability Is More Than A Value It’s Our Starting Point. Our Partner Factories In India Operate On Renewable Energy. We Use Ethically Sourced, Certified Fibers And Biodegradable Textiles. Circular Economy Principles Guide Every Process From Design To Delivery. We're Setting A New Standard For Products That Benefit Both People And The Planet.

items.title: Innovation That Drives Cost Efficiency
items.body: Sustainable Shouldn’t Mean Expensive. We Use Digital Technologies To Streamline Production And Reduce Costs. Our Optimized Methods Ensure High–Quality, Eco–Friendly Products Stay Accessible. Innovation Isn’t Just A Buzzword It’s How We Help Your Business Grow Responsibly.

items.title: Radical Supply Chain Transparency
items.body: We Believe In Earning Trust, Not Assuming It. Every Step Of Our Supply Chain From Raw Materials To Shipping Is Traceable. We Partner Only With Suppliers Who Meet Rigorous Ethical And Labor Standards. You Know Where Your Product Comes From And Who Made It.

vetting.heading:
How We Vet Our
Manufacturing Partners
vetting.intro: We Only Work With Manufacturers Who Match Our Commitment To Sustainability, Ethics, And Innovation. Here’s What We Look For—And Why It Matters To You:

cards.imageAlt: A certification shield with a copyright mark in front of a globe, leaves and garment pattern sketches
cards.title: Certified Sustainability
cards.body: Our Partners Are Globally Certified With Standards Like GOTS, OEKO-TEX, BCI, And GRS, Ensuring Organic Materials, Low-Impact Dyes, And Safe, Transparent Supply Chains.
cards.matters: Why It Matters: You Get Verified Sustainable Products That Meet Global Benchmarks.

cards.imageAlt: A red ribbon winding past a mortar and pestle, a screen-printing frame, factory machinery and a robotic arm
cards.title: Fair Labor & Ethical Practices
cards.body: We Only Collaborate With Factories That Ensure Fair Wages, Safe Working Conditions, And No Exploitation— Verified Through Fair Trade, WRAP, And SEDEX Audits.
cards.matters: Why It Matters: Your Brand Stands For Dignity And Respect At Every Step

cards.imageAlt: Textile machinery connected by glowing icons for Wi-Fi, AI, blockchain, security and speed
cards.title: Industry 4.0 Innovation
cards.body: From IoT To Blockchain And AI-Driven Production, Our Partners Use Advanced Tech To Reduce Waste, Improve Quality, And Ensure Product Traceability.
cards.matters: Why It Matters: You Get Better Quality, Faster Timelines, And Future-Ready Manufacturing.

cards.imageAlt: A gold-ringed medallion showing raw cotton, a factory and finished folded fabric
cards.title: Vertical Integration
cards.body: We Work With Vertically Integrated Factories That Control Every Step From Raw Material To Finished Product, Reducing Carbon Footprint And Increasing Quality Control.
cards.matters: Why It Matters: Greater Efficiency, Fewer Middlemen, And Smoother Production.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.intro: We Only Work With Manufacturers Who Match Our Commitment To Sustainability, Ethics, And Innovation. Here’s What We Look For—And Why It Matters To You:
howItWorks.imageAlt: Serpentine collage of a stepwell, brass and ceramic wares, a textile mill and a container ship

steps.title: Free, No-Pressure Consultation
steps.body: Start With A Complimentary Consultation To Explore Your Goals And Understand What Success Looks Like For Your Brand.

steps.title: Personalized Manufacturer Matchmaking
steps.body: We Carefully Select The Right Manufacturing Partner Based On Your Product’s Unique Needs—Ensuring Alignment In Quality, Capacity, And Values.

steps.title: Full Transparency, Always
steps.body: No Hidden Fees, No Middlemen Games. You’ll Have Full Visibility Into Supplier Remuneration, With A Strict No-Kickback, No-Bribe Policy In Place.

steps.title: Platform-Based Partnership, Not Brokers
steps.body: We Don’t Negotiate Behind Closed Doors—We Create The Space For Ethical, Open Collaboration Between Brands And Manufacturers.

steps.title: Verified Quality Standards
steps.body: All Partners Adhere To Global Certifications Like ISO, GOTS, And Fair Trade. We Ensure Your Product Meets The Highest Benchmarks For Quality And Sustainability
